method: A rear choke runs choke_back (600 ms) and choke_loop (1400 ms) with the victim struggling; when the choker is hit during the loop the victim breaks free natively (choke_combat_lose, 1500 ms, census variant 4) and stays alive and alert. Harness 1444/1448 places the source behind the bound tall overseer on Edge of the World, presses the choke and lands the lab-only sword hit (coop_lab_hit sword back) 1.2 s later. The source streams the choke variants (1-4); the partner plays the choke and the breakout (candidate 592's combat-lose clip). The victim's side: for a client-sourced choke the host's NPC follows the client's paired poses (PairedHold, then released at the escape); for a host-sourced choke the client's replica follows the host's native NPC. The case records the source states, the choke scenes, the NPC authority status during and after the choke and the outcome (alive in both worlds).

items.scope: Both roles: the victim's struggle in the rear choke and its escape (the choker thrown off, the victim free and alive), presented on the partner with the victim's side following in the observer's world.

visual.verdict: Emily's rear choke of the tall overseer on Edge of the World, Corvo's window: Emily grabs him from behind and he struggles in the hold; after the lab hit he elbows free, Emily stumbles back and recovers standing, and he turns on her alive and alert (sword drawn), matching choke_combat_lose in the scene watch. Accepted.

Corvo's rear choke of the tall overseer, Emily's window: Corvo grabs him from behind, the overseer flails his arms in the hold, then elbows Corvo in the face; Corvo doubles over and straightens while the overseer walks off alive and later attacks him. Natural full-body breakout matching choke_combat_lose. Accepted.
